content.text: Now let me integrate the accelerator into the digest:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src = open('collector.py').read()

# import builder hook
old = """import struct
import zlib
import hashlib

MASK24 = 0xFFFFFF"""
new = """import struct
import zlib
import hashlib

import builder

MASK24 = 0xFFFFFF"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

old = """GOLDEN = 0x9e3779b9
MIX1 = 0x85ebca6b
MIX2 = 0xc2b2ae35"""
new = """GOLDEN = 0x9e3779b9
MIX1 = 0x85ebca6b
MIX2 = 0xc2b2ae35

_PACK_SLOT = struct.Struct('<QB').pack
_ONE = b'\\x01'
_ZERO = b'\\x00'
_FNV = None


def use_accelerator():
    \"\"\"Bind the optional C fold; called once before the first case runs.\"\"\"
    global _FNV
    lib = builder.accelerator()
    if lib is not None:
        _FNV = lib.epic_fnv1a
    return _FNV"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

# replace digest with parts + fold
start = src.index('    def digest(self):')
end = src.index('    def digest_hex(self):')
old = src[start:end]
new = '''    def _digest_parts(self):
        """Certificate byte sequence, as a list of pieces (spec order)."""
        prim = self.prim
        slots = self.slots
        pack_slot = _PACK_SLOT
        one = _ONE
        zero = _ZERO
        parts = []
        if prim == GATHER:
            for p in sorted(slots):
                slot = slots[p]
                parts.append(pack_slot(p, slot[0]))
                parts.append(one if slot[1] else zero)
                vals = slot[2]
                for r in range(4):
                    value = vals[r]
                    if value is None:
                        parts.append(zero)
                    else:
                        parts.append(one)
                        parts.append(value)
        elif prim == BCAST:
            for p in sorted(slots):
                slot = slots[p]
                parts.append(pack_slot(p, slot[0]))
                parts.append(one if slot[1] else zero)
                parts.append(slot[2])
        elif prim == BARRIER:
            for p in sorted(slots):
                slot = slots[p]
                parts.append(pack_slot(p, slot[0]))
                parts.append(one if slot[1] else zero)
        else:
            pack_words = self.packLE
            for p in sorted(slots):
                slot = slots[p]
                parts.append(pack_slot(p, slot[0]))
                parts.append(one if slot[1] else zero)
                parts.append(pack_words(*slot[2]))
        return parts

    def digest(self):
        fold = _FNV
        if fold is not None:
            data = b''.join(self._digest_parts())
            return fold(FNV_OFFSET, data, len(data))
        h = FNV_OFFSET
        for part in self._digest_parts():
            for x in part:
                h = ((h ^ x) * FNV_PRIME) & MASK64
        return h

'''
src = src.replace(old, new)

# add packLE to __init__
old = """        self.packD = struct.Struct('!%dI' % words).pack"""
new = """        self.packD = struct.Struct('!%dI' % words).pack
        self.packLE = struct.Struct('<%dI' % words).pack"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('collector.py','w').write(src)
print('ok')
PYEOF
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('solver.py').read()
old = """def solve(request):
    cases = request['cases']
    if not cases:
        return {'cases': []}
    return {'cases': [_run_case(case) for case in cases]}"""
new = """def solve(request):
    cases = request['cases']
    if not cases:
        return {'cases': []}
    import collector
    collector.use_accelerator()
    return {'cases': [_run_case(case) for case in cases]}"""
assert old in src
open('solver.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
print('ok')
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 -I -B project/solver.py < /tmp/req2.json > /tmp/out2.json && python3 -c "
import json; print('public match', json.load(open('/tmp/out2.json'))==json.load(open('/workspace/examples.json'))[1]['output'])" && time (python3 -I -B project/solver.py < /tmp/big3.json > /tmp/o3.json) && head -c 200 /tmp/o3.json
